products.title: NovaBuds Pro Wireless Earbuds
products.excerpt: Punchy sound, 36-hour battery and ANC that genuinely works.
products.lead: If you've been waiting for budget earbuds that don't sound like a tin can, these are the pair I recommend.
products.verdict: For under ₹2,000 these are a steal. Grab them before the deal ends.

products.title: GlowDrift Smart LED Light Strip
products.excerpt: App and music-sync RGB lighting that transforms a room in minutes.
products.lead: The single cheapest upgrade that made my room look twice as expensive.
products.verdict: Best bang-for-buck room upgrade. Instant ambience without spending much.

products.title: TerraFlask Insulated Steel Bottle
products.excerpt: Keeps drinks cold 24 hours and hot for 12 — leak-proof and tough.
products.lead: The first bottle that genuinely kept ice overnight in an Indian summer.
cons: Too wide for some cup holders
products.verdict: If you buy one bottle this year, make it this. The insulation is the real deal.

products.title: Lumè 15% Vitamin C Glow Serum
products.excerpt: Lightweight brightening serum that evens out tone over a few weeks.
products.lead: Most vitamin C serums are sticky or fizzle fast. This one struck a rare balance.
products.verdict: A reliable, beginner-friendly vitamin C that punches above its price.

products.title: CinePop Mini Portable Projector
products.excerpt: Pocket-sized projector that turns any wall into movie night.
products.lead: For the price of a few cinema tickets, this turned my wall into a 100-inch screen.
products.verdict: A brilliant budget entry into projectors. Pair with a Bluetooth speaker.

products.title: BrewLab French Press 600ml
products.excerpt: Thick glass and a 4-level filter that makes cafe-grade coffee at home.
products.lead: I switched from instant to this and stopped buying coffee out completely.
products.verdict: The easiest upgrade from instant coffee. Pays for itself in weeks.
